agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/tokens.py: _TokenType.__getattr__ now raises AttributeError for dunder attribute names (as its comment always intended) instead of creating/returning a new _TokenType instance. This was causing copy.deepcopy/copy.copy (which probe for __deepcopy__/__reduce_ex__/etc via getattr) to receive a non-callable _TokenType object and then attempt to call it, producing 'TypeError: _TokenType object is not callable' — the reported 'copy issue672' failure. Verified via manual script that copy.deepcopy(tokens.Keyword), copy.copy(tokens.Keyword), and normal sqlparse.parse() all work correctly after the fix.
